questions.title: Does the half fee in the first week overdue continue?
questions.question: The ticket says accounting has charged half the late fee "until now" when an invoice is less than a week overdue. Should the nightly billing run keep doing that, or charge the full 2% from the first day overdue? For example, on a $100 unpaid invoice that is 3 days overdue, the fee is either $1 or $2.

options.label: Keep it: half fee (1%) for the first week, then the full 2%
options.clarification: While an invoice is less than 7 days (7 × 24 hours) past its due date, the late fee is half of the 2% fee (1% of the unpaid balance). From 7 days overdue on, it is the full 2%.

options.label: Drop it: full 2% from the first day overdue
options.clarification: The first-week half fee is discontinued. Any overdue invoice is charged the full 2% late fee on its unpaid balance, however few days it is overdue.
